create.name: Rabbi Brian Yosef Schachter-Brooks
create.bio:
Rabbi Brian Yosef Schachter-Brooks is a Jewish meditation teacher, rabbi and musician living in Tucson, Arizona. He grew up in a largely secular household but was drawn to Judaism as a boy, and went on to qualify as a teacher of Jewish meditation under Rabbi Avram Davis in 2004. Reb Zalman Schachter-Shalomi later named him a Minister of Sacred Music, and in 2023 he was ordained as a rabbi in the Jewish Renewal lineage by a circle of rabbis in Ashland, Oregon. He also studied music at the Eastman School and has been teaching Judaism and its contemplative side to young people and adults since 2000.

In 2016, while living in Costa Rica, he started Torah of Awakening, an online community built around what he calls Integral Jewish Meditation. It draws on Kabbalah, Hasidic teaching and the Hebrew letters to guide students towards a direct sense of presence beneath thought and feeling. Members meditate with him live on Zoom several days a week, and a year-long programme, The Art of Judaism, trains adults to lead prayer and meditation themselves. In Tucson he leads Shabbat mornings at Congregation Bet Shalom, and he travels to Berkeley for musical Shabbat and High Holy Day services. He wrote Kabbalah for Beginners and Integral Jewish Meditation, and officiates weddings with his wife, Lisa.

books.title: Kabbalah for Beginners: Understanding and Applying Kabbalistic History, Concepts, and Practices
books.author: Brian Yosef Schachter-Brooks
books.description: A short introduction to Jewish mysticism for newcomers, covering where Kabbalah came from, its central ideas such as the Tree of Life and the view of God as being itself, and simple practices for bringing them into daily life. Published by Callisto (Rockridge Press) in 2020.

courses.title: Torah of Awakening membership
courses.description: An online community for Integral Jewish Meditation. Members can join live sessions of chanting, Torah learning and meditation on Zoom five days a week, browse a library of recorded teachings and book coaching with Rabbi Brian Yosef. The first level of instruction is free to join.

courses.title: The Art of Judaism: Adult B'nai Mitzvah and Meditation Guide Training
courses.description: A twelve-month online cohort for adults who want to learn the foundations of Torah through a Kabbalistic lens, read the Hebrew letters as symbols, and practise leading prayer, chant and meditation in community. New cohorts start each year; get in touch through the page for dates.

courses.title: Seven Keys for Mastering Presence
courses.description: Brian Yosef's full programme of upper-level Integral Kabbalah practices, taught through two phases of video lessons with a practice book, chant recordings, a private session and three months of the advanced membership. Completing it opens the twice-weekly upper-level Zoom sessions.

courses.title: Integral Jewish Weddings
courses.description: Wedding ceremonies led by Rabbi Brian Yosef and Lisa Schachter-Brooks that keep Jewish tradition while welcoming all, with music and a focus on heart-centred presence. Couples arrange a call by email to plan the day.

free_resources.title: Rabbi Brian Yosef Schachter-Brooks on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided Jewish meditations, chants and short teachings rooted in Kabbalah and the Hebrew letters, free to hear in the app or on the web, including an introduction to Integral Jewish Meditation.

free_resources.title: 20-Minute Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of free twenty-minute guided Jewish meditations on video, each with a printable sheet of the affirmations and chant used in the practice.

free_resources.title: YOM RISHON: Sing, Pray, Meditate
free_resources.description: A free Sunday service on Zoom, open to all, that combines meditation, traditional Jewish prayer and music with a journey through the Hebrew letters and the Tree of Life.
